text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime minister praises relations with Egypt.
- Figures show 30 percent of marriages in Bahrain end up in divorce.
- Cargo traffic at Mina Salman Port, the island's main seaport, rises by more than 40,000 tonnes in the first six months of 1997 to 823,660 tonnes.
- Free trade drive backed by cabinet.
- Commercial arbitration is the focus of two seminars taking place in Bahrain this year.
- Bahrain International Exhibition Centre undertakes an expansion project to increase space for hosting exhibitions.
- Bahrain Studies and Research Centre is to organise a conference on science and industry in April.
- Bahrain's cabinet agrees to amend trade agencies law.
